setData.questLineDescription:
With the threat of the Barant Imperium nullified for the moment, tensions are rising. Each Syndicate is rushing to fill the power vacuum, take control of the system's lawless frontier, and stockpile Dark Matter Ingots.

Meanwhile, Aunor and Eido are taking advantage of the chaos as they ready themselves to broadcast the Prophecy to Tharsis Outpost and the Last City.

It's time to work outside the law. Help Eido with the broadcaster repairs, and meet with the Syndicates and choose who you'll back in the territory war to come—at least, at first.
setData.questStepSummary:
Aunor and Eido intend to declassify the Prophecy that the Vanguard have kept under wraps. The people of the City, and of Tharsis Outpost, deserve to know what they're facing. 

Together, they have been working to restore a local broadcaster to spread the message. Aunor asks that we retrieve the remaining components.

setData.questLineDescription:
With the threat of the Barant Imperium nullified for the moment, tensions are rising. Each Syndicate is rushing to fill the power vacuum, take control of the system's lawless frontier, and stockpile Dark Matter Ingots.

Meanwhile, Aunor and Eido are taking advantage of the chaos as they ready themselves to broadcast the Prophecy to Tharsis Outpost and the Last City.

It's time to work outside the law. Help Eido with the broadcaster repairs, and meet with the Syndicates and choose who you'll back in the territory war to come—at least, at first.

setData.questLineDescription:
With the threat of the Barant Imperium nullified for the moment, tensions are rising. Each Syndicate is rushing to fill the power vacuum, take control of the system's lawless frontier, and stockpile Dark Matter Ingots.

Meanwhile, Aunor and Eido are taking advantage of the chaos as they ready themselves to broadcast the Prophecy to Tharsis Outpost and the Last City.

It's time to work outside the law. Help Eido with the broadcaster repairs, and meet with the Syndicates and choose who you'll back in the territory war to come—at least, at first.

setData.questLineDescription:
With the threat of the Barant Imperium nullified for the moment, tensions are rising. Each Syndicate is rushing to fill the power vacuum, take control of the system's lawless frontier, and stockpile Dark Matter Ingots.

Meanwhile, Aunor and Eido are taking advantage of the chaos as they ready themselves to broadcast the Prophecy to Tharsis Outpost and the Last City.

It's time to work outside the law. Help Eido with the broadcaster repairs, and meet with the Syndicates and choose who you'll back in the territory war to come—at least, at first.
setData.questStepSummary: Meet with Spider in his lounge for a discussion about current events on Tharsis, and your role in them.

With the threat of the Barant Imperium nullified for the moment, tensions are rising. Each Syndicate is rushing to fill the power vacuum, take control of the system's lawless frontier, and stockpile Dark Matter Ingots.

Meanwhile, Aunor and Eido are taking advantage of the chaos as they ready themselves to broadcast the Prophecy to Tharsis Outpost and the Last City.

It's time to work outside the law. Help Eido with the broadcaster repairs, and meet with the Syndicates and choose who you'll back in the territory war to come—at least, at first.
setData.questStepSummary: Contracts award Credits, Dark Matter Ingots, Syndicate Reputation, and more. Completed Priority Contracts will reset daily. Syndicate Contracts are automatically refreshed after completion.

displayProperties.description:
Strengthen your ties and unlock greater rewards by reaching Rank 3 with any of the Syndicates.

Completing Contracts and depositing Dark Matter Ingots at a Syndicate's War Chest will increase your reputation with that Syndicate.
displayProperties.name: The Territory War Begins

setData.questLineDescription:
With the threat of the Barant Imperium nullified for the moment, tensions are rising. Each Syndicate is rushing to fill the power vacuum, take control of the system's lawless frontier, and stockpile Dark Matter Ingots.

Meanwhile, Aunor and Eido are taking advantage of the chaos as they ready themselves to broadcast the Prophecy to Tharsis Outpost and the Last City.

It's time to work outside the law. Help Eido with the broadcaster repairs, and meet with the Syndicates and choose who you'll back in the territory war to come—at least, at first.
setData.questStepSummary: You may complete any Syndicate's Contracts and deposit Dark Matter Ingots at any Syndicate's War Chest, despite your current allyship.

displayProperties.description:
A new day has dawned on the Lawless Frontier. Because you completed yesterday's Priority Contract, competing Syndicates will now offer you additional incentives for allying with them instead.

You may now ally with a different Syndicate for extra rewards or stay loyal to your current Syndicate and keep doing Jobs.

The choice is yours.
displayProperties.name: The Territory War Begins

setData.questLineDescription:
With the threat of the Barant Imperium nullified for the moment, tensions are rising. Each Syndicate is rushing to fill the power vacuum, take control of the system's lawless frontier, and stockpile Dark Matter Ingots.

Meanwhile, Aunor and Eido are taking advantage of the chaos as they ready themselves to broadcast the Prophecy to Tharsis Outpost and the Last City.

It's time to work outside the law. Help Eido with the broadcaster repairs, and meet with the Syndicates and choose who you'll back in the territory war to come—at least, at first.
setData.questStepSummary: It's important to complete your Priority Contract from the Map Guide each day if you wish to maximize the rewards offered by other Syndicates the following day.

"Anomaly-Blessed, we rejoice in your victory. As does the Altar. It finds synchronicity with a new object on Kepler, but not a strangelet. We have not seen this type of connection before, and believe it is for you."

It seems the Altar, or the Nine, have more to show you.
